text: {"table": {"name": "constructorStandings", "purpose": "Formula 1 constructor (team) championship standings after each race: one row per constructor per race, with cumulative points, championship position, and win count at that point in the season."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "constructorStandingsId", "description": "Surrogate primary key uniquely identifying each standings row.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "raceId", "description": "Reference to races.col_001; the race after which the standings were computed.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "constructorId", "description": "Reference to constructors.col_001; the team whose standing this row records.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_004": {"role": "numeric", "name": "points", "description": "Cumulative championship points for the constructor at that race; can be fractional (e.g. 27.5, 72.5) due to shared points or half-point races.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_005": {"role": "numeric", "name": "position", "description": "Numeric championship position of the constructor after that race (1-22).", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "numeric", "name": "positionText", "description": "Position rendered as text (same values as col_005); stored as VARCHAR.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_007": {"role": "numeric", "name": "wins", "description": "Number of race wins by the constructor up to and including that race (mostly 0).", "status": "resolved"}}}
